name: Game Kastle Austin
address: 3407 Wells Branch Pkwy, Suite 800, Austin, TX 78727
when: Pokémon TCG league nights Tuesdays at 6:30 PM (per the store's posts; $12 entry, promo pack for every player)
kids: Registered Play! Pokémon league location. Weeknight start time works for school-age kids; a parent should plan to stay.
note: Also hosts League Cups. Bring your child's Play! Pokémon ID if they want to earn points.
imageAlt: Game Kastle Austin play area (photo from the store's site)

name: Card Traders of Austin
address: 8650 Spicewood Springs Rd, Suite 133A, Austin, TX 78759
when: Weekly Pokémon TCG night at 6:30 PM (sign-up 6:00–6:30 PM, $5 entry, a booster pack with entry); the store calendar lists it on Mondays
kids: Low $5 entry and a pack with every entry make it an easy first event. The store says beginners are welcome.
note: Card shop focused on trading cards. Check the store's events page for the current night before you go.
imageAlt: Card Traders of Austin storefront (photo from the store's site)

name: Bandito Comics
when: Casual league play, League Challenges, League Cups and prereleases (see the store's TCG events page for dates)
kids: The store's events page says all skill levels are welcome, including first-time players.
note: Comic shop that also runs One Piece, Lorcana and other card games, so check that the night you pick is a Pokémon one.
imageAlt: Illustration: kids and parents at a card league night

name: Dragon's Lair Comics & Fantasy
address: 2438 W Anderson Ln, Suite B-1, Austin, TX 78757
when: Pokémon prereleases and League Cups on the store calendar; a Pokémon Delta Reign prerelease is listed for Sun, Nov 1 at noon. Its official league listing showed as inactive when we checked
kids: Long-running Austin game store (since 1986) with a large play area. It has run younger-player Pokémon clubs in the past.
note: Tournaments need a Play! Pokémon ID and a 60-card Standard deck. Prereleases are a good intro because everyone opens new packs.
imageAlt: Inside Dragon's Lair Austin (photo from the store's site)

name: Mothership Books and Games
when: Pokémon League sessions listed on Fridays (5 PM) and Saturdays (noon), plus 'Pokémon Fridays' events at 7 PM
kids: Saturday-midday league session is the most kid-friendly time slot we found in Austin.
note: Also runs many other card games. Schedule here is from the official event locators via Where2PlayTCG, so confirm with the store.
imageAlt: Illustration: kids and parents at a card league night

name: Pat's Games
when: Open Tue–Fri afternoons/evenings and Saturdays (per a public directory). Ask the store about Pokémon league nights
kids: Directory reviews mention MSRP pricing on new sets, which helps parents buying packs.
note: Sells Pokémon sealed product. We could not confirm a current league night, so call ahead: (512) 786-1861.
imageAlt: Illustration: a family at a local card shop counter

name: Black Castle Gamez
address: 1335 E Whitestone Blvd, Suite O-300, Cedar Park, TX 78613
when: Pokémon League Thursdays at 6 PM, plus TCG Challenges and League Cups on Saturdays (per the official event locator)
kids: Regular Thursday league and Saturday events give families two options.
note: Shares the same plaza address as Bamboo Trading Card Shop.
imageAlt: Illustration: kids and parents at a card league night

name: Bamboo Trading Card Shop
address: 1335 E Whitestone Blvd, Cedar Park, TX 78613
when: Open daily from 10 AM. Community-listed Pokémon League on Thursdays at 6 PM
kids: Public reviews describe it as welcoming and trustworthy, which matters if your child is selling or trading cards.
note: Sells Pokémon singles and sealed product.
imageAlt: Illustration: a family at a local card shop counter

name: Card Gurus
address: 2401 W Pecan St, Suite 102, Pflugerville, TX 78660
when: Tue–Sat 12–8 PM, Sun 1–6 PM. Has hosted Pokémon league nights and prereleases; dates change
kids: Has game tables for casual play. It's also a PokéStop in Pokémon GO, which kids may enjoy.
note: Several small Pokémon sellers rent booths inside, so prices differ from case to case. Compare before you buy.
imageAlt: Inside Card Gurus (photo from the shop's site)

name: Rogues Gallery Comics + Games
address: 1601 S I-35 Frontage Rd #330, Round Rock, TX 78664
when: Open daily 11 AM–7 PM. Holds in-store events; ask about Pokémon nights
kids: Comic and game shop with board games too, so the whole family has something to browse.
note: Sells Pokémon cards and booster packs. We did not find a posted Pokémon league schedule.
imageAlt: Illustration: a family at a local card shop counter

name: Multiverse Hobbies
when: Open Mon–Sat 4–9 PM (per a public directory). Hosts Pokémon tournaments; call for dates: (512) 846-3176
kids: Local players recommend it for Round Rock and Hutto families who don't want to drive into Austin.
note: Pokémon-focused shop. Details here come from public directories, so confirm before you go.
imageAlt: Illustration: a family at a local card shop counter

name: ATX Card Show Weekend (Oct 31 – Nov 1)
address: Hilton Austin, 500 E 4th St, Austin, TX 78701
kids: 300+ tables. Past ATX shows let kids 5 and under in free with a paying adult. Advance GA tickets were about $4 ($10 at the door).
note: Big mixed sports and TCG show. Set your child a budget before you walk in.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: ATX North Card Show (Belton)
address: Huntington Bank Expo (Bell County Expo), 301 W Loop 121, Belton, TX 76513
when: Sat Nov 21 (10 AM–5 PM) & Sun Nov 22 (11 AM–4 PM), 2026
kids: 400+ tables with a dedicated Pokémon section. Kids 5 and under free; free parking.
note: Advance GA $6 Saturday / $4 Sunday; $10 at the door. Sunday is quieter for little ones.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: Home Town Card Show: Austin Marriott South
address: Austin Marriott South, 4415 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Austin, TX 78744
kids: Free entry and free parking, which makes it easy to try with kids over Thanksgiving weekend.
note: Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh! and sports cards.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: Mom and Pop Card Show: South Austin
address: Ant's Beer Cave, 440 E St Elmo Rd, Unit E-2, Austin, TX 78745
kids: The venue is a beer business, so check the organizer's page for age rules before bringing kids.
note: Small local show with Pokémon and sports cards.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: Home Town Card Show: Red Oak Ballroom
address: Norris Conference Center, 2525 W Anderson Ln, Suite 365, Austin, TX 78757
kids: Free admission and free parking. Indoor ballroom, good for holiday gift shopping.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: Mom and Pop Card Show: Leander
address: The Fieldhouse at the Crossover, 1717 Scottsdale Dr, Suite 160, Leander, TX 78641
kids: Described as an all-ages show with food trucks.
note: Listed admission is about $7.72. Pokémon, One Piece and sports cards.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor

name: ATX Card Show Weekend (Dec 19–20)
address: Hilton Austin, 500 E 4th St, Austin, TX 78701
kids: Austin's biggest regular show. Check the organizer's page for December ticket prices and the kids policy.
note: The last big show before Christmas.
imageAlt: Illustration: families walking a card show floor
